def: to be hostile (only active participle an opponent)

occurrences.text: Lead me, O Lord, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
